source: Warstadt et al., 'Findings of the BabyLM Challenge: Sample-efficient pretraining on developmentally plausible corpora', CoNLL-BabyLM 2023, Table 2 (arXiv:2504.08165). BLiMP is the mean accuracy over its 67 phenomena, reported to two decimals.
protocol: Zero-shot BLiMP minimal pairs scored by the model's log-likelihood of each sentence. OPT-125M is the best provided baseline trained on the 100M-word Strict track; ELC-BERT and BootBERT are Strict-track submissions; RoBERTa-base and Llama 2 are skylines trained on their full pre-training corpora, far more than 100M words.
